# WebView2 SDK files

These files come from `Microsoft.Web.WebView2` NuGet package `1.0.4258.31`.
MoE4All bundles the managed assemblies and x64 loader only. The browser engine is
the Microsoft WebView2 Evergreen Runtime installed on Windows and is not bundled.

The upstream license is preserved as `Microsoft.Web.WebView2.LICENSE.txt`.
